title: Feuds and Wanted heroes
changes: Clans now fight only clans whose land borders theirs: if you are sworn, soldiers of a clan your clan does not border leave you alone. A badge shows how the land's clan sees you.
Shift+click a soldier or a Hold of a clan that leaves you alone to strike at it on purpose: its soldiers fight you (and your party) for 10 minutes.

Killing a clan's people makes you Wanted, then Hunted, then Marked by it: its soldiers see you from farther, manhunters march out after you, and other heroes see the mark. It fades over time, or ends when that clan kills you.
Heroes sworn to a clan earn a bounty for killing someone Wanted by it, once per hero per day.
